title: Duplicate charge on monthly invoice
body: Customer was charged twice for the same invoice after a payment retry. Both charges appeared on the card statement.
resolution: Refunded the duplicate charge and confirmed the retry job is idempotent.

title: Invoice shows wrong seat count after downgrade
body: Seat reduction made mid-cycle was not reflected on the next invoice and the customer was billed for the old count.
resolution: Regenerated the invoice with the correct seat count and issued a credit.

title: Refund for accidental annual upgrade
body: Customer upgraded to an annual plan by mistake and asked for a refund the same day.
resolution: Refunded in full under the 14 day policy and reverted the plan.

title: Payment failed and account about to suspend
body: Card declined and the retry payment button in the dashboard did nothing. Account showed a suspension warning.
resolution: Retried the charge manually and extended the grace period by seven days.

title: Sales tax applied to tax exempt customer
body: Tax exempt certificate was on file but invoices still included sales tax.
resolution: Marked the account tax exempt and credited the tax from the last three invoices.

title: Proration amount on mid-cycle downgrade
body: Customer questioned the prorated credit after moving from a higher plan to a lower tier part way through the cycle.
resolution: Explained the daily proration formula and attached the calculation.

title: Change billing contact email and address on invoices
body: Receipts and invoices went to an old mailbox and showed an outdated company address.
resolution: Updated the billing contact and address and reissued the latest invoice.

title: Tax form and vendor paperwork request
body: Enterprise customer needed a tax form and a vendor registration letter for their accounts payable team.
resolution: Sent the signed tax form and vendor letter from the finance mailbox.

title: SMS two-factor codes not delivered
body: Users did not receive SMS verification codes for several hours while authenticator app codes kept working.
resolution: SMS provider outage. Advised switching to the authenticator app and issued backup codes.

title: Password reset link expired immediately
body: The password reset link reported as expired the moment it was opened, leaving the user locked out.
resolution: Clock skew on the mail relay. Reissued the link manually and fixed the relay clock.

title: SAML login fails after identity provider certificate rotation
body: All SSO users received an invalid SAML response error after the identity provider rotated its signing certificate.
resolution: Uploaded the new identity provider certificate in the SSO settings and logins recovered.

title: Cannot remove former admin from workspace
body: The remove button was disabled for a departed administrator because they held the last admin seat.
resolution: Promoted another user to admin first, then removed the departed account.

title: Revoked API key still accepted
body: Requests signed with a revoked API key kept succeeding for up to fifteen minutes after revocation.
resolution: Key cache TTL. Purged the cache immediately and rotated the key.

title: Suspicious login from unfamiliar location
body: Customer received a login alert from a country where none of their staff are located and asked to force logout all sessions.
resolution: Revoked all sessions, required a password reset and enabled two-factor for the workspace.

title: Recovery codes rejected after losing phone
body: User lost the two-factor device and the printed recovery codes did not work.
resolution: Verified identity through the account owner and reset two-factor.

title: Email change confirmation never arrives
body: Confirmation email for an account email change was never delivered so the change could not complete.
resolution: Address was on the bounce list. Cleared it and resent the confirmation.

title: Dashboard returns 502 for all users
body: Gateway errors across the whole dashboard during a deployment affected every customer.
resolution: Rolled back the deployment and published an incident review.

title: Webhook delivery delayed
body: Webhooks arrived thirty to sixty minutes late because the delivery queue backed up.
resolution: Scaled the webhook workers and drained the queue.

title: Exports stuck in processing
body: Export jobs never completed after a storage failover and stayed in the processing state.
resolution: Restarted the export workers and re-ran the stuck jobs.

title: Scheduled reports not sent
body: Morning scheduled reports were skipped after a scheduler restart.
resolution: Re-triggered the missed schedules and fixed the scheduler lock.

title: Intermittent timeouts on search API
body: A small share of search requests timed out under load for several hours.
resolution: Added capacity to the search cluster and raised the timeout.

title: Mobile app blank screen after update
body: The mobile app showed a blank screen on launch after the latest release.
resolution: Released a hotfix and documented clearing the cache as a workaround.

title: Regional slowness in EU
body: Pages loaded slowly for EU customers while US customers were unaffected.
resolution: Database replica lag in the EU region. Failed over the replica.

title: API connection resets while status page shows operational
body: Customer saw connection resets on the API though the status page was green.
resolution: Partial load balancer failure in one zone. Replaced the node and updated the status page.

title: Dark mode for the dashboard
body: Several customers asked for a dark theme for the web dashboard.
resolution: Logged on the roadmap with no release date.

title: Parquet export format
body: Request to export data as Parquet in addition to CSV for analytics pipelines.
resolution: Added to the data export backlog.

title: Per-project permissions
body: Enterprise customer needed project level roles to roll out to more departments.
resolution: Collected requirements and scheduled for a future quarter.

title: SCIM provisioning support
body: Request for SCIM to automate user provisioning and deprovisioning from the identity provider.
resolution: Opened a beta program for enterprise accounts.

title: Keyboard shortcuts
body: Power users asked for keyboard navigation in the ticket list.
resolution: Shipped a first set of shortcuts.

title: Configurable webhook retries
body: Customers wanted to set the retry count and backoff for webhook delivery.
resolution: On the integrations roadmap.

title: Slack integration
body: Request to post notifications into Slack channels.
resolution: Pointed to the generic connector while a native integration is planned.

title: Longer audit log retention
body: Compliance teams asked for audit logs to be kept beyond ninety days.
resolution: Retention extension offered as an enterprise add-on.

title: Impersonation of a company
body: A workspace used another customer's brand name and logo to impersonate them.
resolution: Workspace suspended after verification. Trust and safety handled contact.

title: Spam through shared inbox form
body: Spam messages were submitted through the public inbox form in large numbers.
resolution: Enabled rate limiting and the spam filter on the form.

title: Harassment between workspace members
body: A member reported threatening messages from another member in shared channels.
resolution: Escalated to trust and safety. Offending account suspended.

title: Phishing page on public share link
body: A public share link hosted a fake login page that collected credentials.
resolution: Link disabled within the hour and the account banned.

title: Automated scraper flooding a public form
body: Thousands of bot submissions per hour from rotating IP addresses hit a customer's public form.
resolution: Blocked the traffic pattern and added a challenge to the form.

title: Pirated content distribution
body: Report that a workspace was used to share copyrighted material.
resolution: Content removed after notice and the account warned.

title: Threatening message referencing a physical location
body: Customer received a message that referenced their office address and made a threat.
resolution: Escalated to trust and safety and the law enforcement liaison.

title: Fake reviews in the community forum
body: Fake negative reviews about a customer's product were posted in the community forum.
resolution: Reviews removed and the posting accounts banned.
